1.ClueText: Lately, many heroes have been staying in and not fought with anyone, which is unusual.

2.ClueText: Many beasts have appeared in the city recently for unknown reasons.

3.ClueText: It's said that many people have been stolen from, but no-one knows what exactly they have lost.

4.ClueText: The firearms in the city's arsenal have all been sold out.

5.ClueText: Recently, a ship has set sail secretly without notice.

6.ClueText: A mysterious Hypogean has been seen in the city.

7.ClueText: The city's most famous builders have received a mysterious commission.

8.ClueText: A mysterious building has been discovered, that looks like a creepy gallery.

9.ClueText: Someone has used a hero's unique skill.

10.ClueText: Many claim to have been accepted as a student by a special teacher.

11.ClueText: A magical potion has emerged in the black market, touted as a cure for all diseases.

12.ClueText: Someone has entered the gallery and stolen an item from its collection.

13.ClueText: The thief who stole from the gallery has traveled to the vagabonds' settlement outside the city.

14.ClueText: Someone has used the heroes' unique skills again, with a force that's significantly enhanced.

15.ClueText: Besides the items, the thief has also stolen other treasures whose whereabouts are now unknown.

16.ClueText: The curator did not seek to recover the items after they had been stolen from the gallery.

17.ClueText: A dignified outfit that a vagabond had custom made at a clothing shop.

18.ClueText: A bandit camp outside the city, now completely deserted.

19.ClueText: A wealthy and well-known businessman passed away suddenly, and word has it that his estate will go to his illegitimate son.

20.ClueText: In recent months, a scholar has been offering free instruction in the city.

21.ClueText: Before the tycoon died, he'd been visited by a machinist friend he hadn't seen in years.

22.ClueText: The tycoon had attached great importance to the pocket watch—he even slept wearing it.

23.ClueText: Rumor has it that the tycoon acquired a mysterious magical object for a high price in his later years.

24.ClueText: The gravekeeper heard a faint sound of movement coming from the cemetery at night.

25.ClueText: In his youth, the tycoon had proclaimed that he'd acquired an invaluable treasure on his journeys.

26.ClueText: Nobody knows how the tycoon managed to amass so much wealth back then.

27.ClueText: The tycoon never married, having rejected the advances of many women.

28.ClueText: Legend has it that the tycoon's pocket watch contained one of his secrets.

29.ClueText: The pocket watch is crafted from special metals and jewels, giving it a luxurious appearance.

30.ClueText: Writing is engraved on the interior of the watch, consisting of both letters and numbers.

31.ClueText: The pocket watch is crafted to a high degree of precision, allowing it to serve as a chronometer for sea navigation.

32.ClueText: The pocket watch was crafted by a world-class clocksmith.
